GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages. Rider reported that passing the 1300m his saddle slipped forward, which placed him at a disadvantage in riding his mount for the remainder of the race. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: concussion plates(front & hind) off f/t lugging bit off f/t nose roll off f/t Restrained from Wide barrier Settled Down rear 3 Wide With Cover home turn 8l Laid out early & middle stages 200m got on heels weakening runner, steadied outwards for clear run. always in bad spot in Straight Nothing went right Nice return r-instr mount 1st up ride with cover Saved Ground home turn Laid out difficult to find cover. 800 layed out detached from field. Midnful of racing manners elected to wait until balanced up in Straight before placing under pressure. Finished off strongly momentarily steadied 200. # luckless!
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Restrained in the early stages from the outside barrier. Laid out throughout the early and middle stages. Passing the 200m improved onto heels steadied outwards to continue into clear running. Tactics queried RR first up from a spell Ins to ride with cover to save ground rounding home turn. Restrained at start to comply with ins mount laid out from runners proving difficult to find cover. 800m her mount again commenced to lay out and as a result lost ground and became detached from the remainder of the field rounding that turn. Elected to wait until balanced to place under pressure.
